brief: Holds a musical tradition declared as data, and plays a phrase of degrees inside it as a score.
detail: A universe declares a tuning, a pitch vocabulary with movement rules, a rhythmic cycle with accents, ornaments and an instrument set, as a list with no logic; the class reads the declaration and knows no tradition by name. A phrase is written in degrees, so one phrase means something in every universe: 5_ is a degree an octave down and a degree past the mode's size wraps up an octave. Eight traditions ship: western, maqam, tunisian, niger, raga, gamelan, westafrican and flamenco. Every declaration carries its sources and the line listener, UNPERCEIVED until a person from the tradition has heard it, and none has. Nothing here opens an audio device.
